title: DJI official online store prices by country (DJI Index)
attribution: DJI Index (https://djiindex.com), from prices on DJI's official online stores
source: DJI official online stores, one request per product page, once a day
notes: prices: the store price in major units of the store currency (stores[market].currency), for the kit named in variant.
US, Canada and Puerto Rico prices exclude sales tax and are never called the cheapest; all other stores include VAT/GST.
cheapest: the lowest compared store, converted to USD with the dated fx rate; stores checked more than 72 hours ago, under review or found out of stock are not compared.
Per-store dates, sale prices and stock checks: data_url.
